# proxmox_guest_feature (Data Source)

Checks a guest feature through `GET /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/feature`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_feature" "snapshot" {
  type    = "qemu"
  node    = "pve"
  vmid    = 100
  feature = "snapshot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `snapname` (String)

### Read-Only

- `has_feature` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nodes` (List of String)
